ruleset.name: main-branch-protection
required_status_check_contexts: Reject external QA channel files in product main

findings.title: Self-review allowance documented but not time-boxed
findings.evidence: ruleset.required_approving_review_count=0; SECURITY_AUDIT.md 5.6; ROLLOUT_PLAN.md 9 (step F 2026-12-30) has no enforced expiry in config
findings.impact: Any write-access identity can open and self-merge a PR to main with zero independent approvals.
findings.remediation: Record an explicit review-by/expiry date in the governance doc; set required_approving_review_count=1 at expiry (needs reviewer identity P6). Owner decision.

findings.title: Branch not required to be up to date before merge
findings.impact: A PR can merge while behind main; required checks then validated a base that is not the final merge result.
findings.remediation: Enable strict_required_status_checks_policy once producer flow tolerates rebases. Owner decision.

findings.title: Missing required check: 'Secure QA TLS / RBAC / SQLite Compose (offline live)'
findings.evidence: .github/workflows/native-agent-e2e.yml job protected-qa-live-compose triggers on every PR to main (no paths filter) and was green on main; not in required_status_check_contexts
findings.impact: An always-running integration/security check is not gate-enforced on main.
findings.remediation: Owner adds that context to the ruleset (additive, safe). Do NOT add paths-filtered checks (docker-qa-smoke, frontend npm audit) or the conditional local Compose job - they would block all merges.

findings.title: In-repo required-check list drifted from ruleset (11 vs 14)
findings.evidence: .github/workflows/gitflow-policy.yml REQUIRED_CHECKS lists 11 contexts; ruleset requires 14; ROLLOUT_PLAN.md 6.1 trigger (c)
findings.impact: CI-side detection is weaker than the ruleset; drift is defined as a rollback trigger.
findings.remediation: Update REQUIRED_CHECKS to the exact 14 contexts in the same change as any ruleset edit (ROLLOUT_PLAN.md P5).

findings.title: Applied enforcement pre-empts authoritative staged rollout
findings.evidence: ROLLOUT_PLAN.md prescribes shadow (2026-11-09..23) then one-check-per-step from 2026-11-25 and declares creating a ruleset without P1-P7 a non-success; live ruleset is active with all 14 contexts since 2026-10-29T17:38 MSK
findings.impact: Governed-process deviation; the plan's safety net for blocking producers was not exercised. Not a protection weakness (stricter), but unaudited.
findings.remediation: Owner/reviewer acknowledge the deviation and reconcile ROLLOUT_PLAN.md with applied state, or return to staged enablement. Owner decision.

findings.title: Absent required checks are warned, not failed
findings.evidence: .github/workflows/gitflow-policy.yml required-checks-gate uses core.warning for missing/pending contexts
findings.impact: A required check that stops reporting is not surfaced as a CI failure.
findings.remediation: Escalate 'missing' to failure after the 14-context sync (F-BP-04).

findings.title: Ruleset config was undocumented in REPOSITORY-STRUCTURE.md
findings.impact: Operators could not verify the protected-branch contract from the repo.
findings.remediation: Fixed in this task: docs/architecture/REPOSITORY-STRUCTURE.md section 'GitHub branch protection for main'.

No independent review enforced while F-BP-01 stands.
Stale-base merges possible while F-BP-02 stands.
No signed-commit requirement (SEC-007 interim option A).

22 open Dependabot vulnerabilities on the default branch (2 critical, 5 high, 12 moderate, 3 low) reported by GitHub on 2026-10-29 - a pre-existing dependency backlog that branch protection does not remediate; the paths-filtered 'frontend npm audit (high/critical)' cannot be made a required check.
Client-side --no-verify hooks remain advisory by design; the server-side ruleset is the enforcement point.
